about: Held out (design G 3.7): rewordings of the memory questions with other made-up lines, and a log never seen, run beside test/eval/memory.json with --set memory-held-out. Never put its words in a prompt, a tool text, a document or the other case files, and never tune memory against it: test/memory-questions.test.mjs checks the first. All made up, about a made-up household fleet.
